# 2 Baruch Chapter 62 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 62:3 — temple worship disrupted

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-drew-away-from-the-temple-of-the-LORD the-sacrifices" |
| LOGOS | "they drew away from the temple of the Lord the sacrifices" |
| PNEUMA | "They drew the sacrifices away from the Lord's temple" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac syntax has 'temple of the Lord' as the point of departure; LOGOS preserves this word order while PNEUMA inverts the phrase.

---

## 62:4 — killing the prophets

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-killed-the-prophets; and-the-voice-of-the-righteous was-no-more-heard" |
| LOGOS | "they killed the prophets; and the voice of the righteous was no more heard" |
| PNEUMA | "They killed the prophets; the voice of the righteous was silenced" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Was no more heard' (Syriac: la 'tshma') preserves the passive-cessation nuance; PNEUMA's 'was silenced' implies an active agent which is not in the source.

---
